## UKRAINE — profile (page 233)

- **Header facts:** Region: Europe & Central Asia; Income group: Upper-middle-income; Lending category: IBRD; Data status: Data as reported (A); Population: 39.0 million; GNI: 212,427; Unit line: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** 250,257, **+29.2% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:** 118,566 in 2015 and 250,257 in 2025. The line is broadly flat to slightly rising through much of 2015–22, then rises more sharply in the last years, reaching its **peak in 2025**; unlabeled intermediate points are approximately stable early on and then increase (≈).

- **Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:**
  - **Total external debt:** 250,257
    - **Public & publicly guaranteed:** 173,124
    - **Private nonguaranteed:** 53,980
    - **Short-term:** 23,153
  - **Public & publicly guaranteed — by creditor type:** 173,124
    - **Multilateral:** 131,610
    - **Bilateral:** 13,367
    - **Private creditors:** 28,148
  - **Multilateral:** 131,610
    - **European Union:** 82,272
    - **World Bank-IBRD:** 16,976
    - **Other multilateral:** 32,362
  - **Bilateral:** 13,367
    - **Canada:** 8,873
    - **China:** 1,033
    - **Other bilateral:** 3,461

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25** *(shaded band shows the 25th–75th percentile range of DRS reporting countries)*:
  - **External debt / exports:** 403%, **+37.6%**. Trend: declines in the earlier years, then rises strongly toward 2025, ending at the period high.
  - **External debt / GNI:** 118%, **+16.4%**. Trend: falls from an earlier high, then recovers and rises again toward 2025.
  - **Debt service / exports:** 17%, **+5.8%**. Trend: sharp drop early in the period, then fluctuates at a lower level and edges up slightly by 2025.
  - **Debt service / GNI:** 5%, **-10.6%**. Trend: sharp early decline, then gradual downward movement with minor fluctuations, ending low.

- **Figure 4. Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025:**
  - **Official creditors:** Maturity **40 yrs**; Grace period **10 yrs**; Interest rate **0.2%**
  - **Private creditors:** Maturity **11 yrs**; Grace period **6 yrs**; Interest rate **5.2%**

- **Notes/Source:** US$ million, unless otherwise indicated. Shaded band shows the 25th–75th percentile range of DRS reporting countries. Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
